call-timeout:call.title: No timeout on the call to Partner scoring API
call-timeout:call.message: If it stalls, every thread waits.
call-timeout:call.rationale: A timeout bounds waiting; downstream work can still finish and reply late.
call-timeout:call.shownRationale: Waiting calls retain resources. A timeout bounds waiting; it does not cancel downstream work.
